A style gate that lints the render while the drift gate simultaneously REQUIRES committing that render is two gates fighting over an artifact neither owns; style authority belongs at the AUTHORING site (the DB write), and single-representation says bind there once, not at every render. Concrete trigger: CLAUDE_ADAM.md carried the chairman VERBATIM in a 2026-08-25 ratified constraint about UAT needing to be its own stage, and one word of that quote is blacklisted -- with CLAUDE*.md-protection separately forbidding a hand-edit and the next regen undoing one anyway, three gates left no legal move, which is why that file sat drifted on main. NAMED PRICE of this exclusion: a follow-on SD must add the style check at the DB-write site. BINDING RIDER: chairman VERBATIM quotes are NEVER style-lintable at ANY site -- the write-site check must carry a quoted-text exemption FROM BIRTH, so the narrower option-B principle survives inside option A shape.
